components.name: Book cover
components.description: Binding, ribbon, and title treatment. The production cover also uses the existing lily illustration.
components.html:
3.9 years,
give or take.MISS DEE & THE MENACE

A September, annotated.
components.css: .ds-book{max-width:300px}.ds-cover{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:30px;list-style:none;padding:34px 30px 31px 43px;background:var(--green,#233f35);color:var(--paper,#f7f3e9);border-radius:2px 7px 7px 2px;box-shadow:14px 24px 46px #1d312433;transform:rotate(3deg);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-cover::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-cover:hover{transform:rotate(0) translateY(-5px);box-shadow:18px 30px 50px #1d312438}.ds-cover:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #91652d;outline-offset:5px}.ds-book[open] .ds-cover{transform:rotate(0)}.ds-binding{position:absolute;left:9px;top:0;height:100%;width:8px;border-left:1px solid #ffffff24;border-right:1px solid #00000040}.ds-cover-title{font:500 36px/.98 var(--serif,Cormorant,Georgia,serif);letter-spacing:-.025em;text-align:center;color:var(--gold,#dec797)}.ds-cover-title em{color:var(--paper,#f7f3e9)}.ds-byline{font:11px/1.7 var(--sans,"DM Sans",sans-serif);letter-spacing:.04em;text-align:center}.ds-ribbon{position:absolute;right:28px;top:0;width:18px;height:36px;background:var(--wine,#652f42);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%,50% 76%,0 100%)}.ds-book-paper{padding:24px;background:var(--sheet,#fffdf6);color:var(--green,#233f35);font:500 24px/1.45 var(--serif,Cormorant,Georgia,serif)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-cover{transition:none}}

components.name: Chapter selector
components.description: Persistent three-column chapter navigation with the current chapter marked.
components.css: .ds-chapters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d4d2c0);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d4d2c0);background:var(--sheet,#fffdf6)}.ds-chapters button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:start;gap:4px;min-height:64px;padding:12px 18px;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:2px;background:transparent;color:var(--green,#233f35);font:500 21px/1.2 var(--serif,Cormorant,Georgia,serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-chapters span{font:11px/1.5 var(--sans,"DM Sans",sans-serif);color:var(--muted,#626457)}.ds-chapters button[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--green,#233f35);color:var(--paper,#f7f3e9)}.ds-chapters [aria-current="page"] span{color:var(--gold,#dec797)}.ds-chapters button:not([aria-current="page"]):hover{background:#e9edde}.ds-chapters button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #91652d;outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:650px){.ds-chapters{gap:5px;padding:8px 0}.ds-chapters button{font-size:18px;padding:10px 8px;min-height:83px;justify-content:center}}

components.name: Quiz choice
components.description: Native radio selection on an ivory quiz sheet.
components.html: How long has it been?
components.css: .ds-quiz{padding:35px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:var(--sheet,#fffdf6);color:var(--ink,#34382f)}.ds-quiz legend{font:500 34px/1.1 var(--serif,Cormorant,Georgia,serif);color:var(--green,#233f35)}.ds-quiz label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 14px;margin-top:10px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d4d2c0);font:400 12px/1.7 var(--sans,"DM Sans",sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-quiz input{width:16px;height:16px;margin:0;accent-color:var(--green,#233f35)}.ds-quiz label:has(input:checked){background:#e9edde;border-color:var(--green,#233f35)}.ds-quiz input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #91652d;outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview:
Forest-green binding, ivory pages, and the existing maroon lily illustration introduce a personal account of September. Dated prose explains why each photograph, film, or voice note belongs. The long story starts inside a closed book; optional games, possible plans, quiet notes, and the letter remain outside it.

This system applies to `/miss-dee/` and its compatibility routes. The surrounding Hugo blog keeps its own identity. Source authority is `static/date/date.css`, `static/date/date.js`, `layouts/date/single.html`, the `date-media` and `date-story-media` partials, and the two `dee_media` and `dee_story` data files. `PRODUCT.md` records the product constraints; `.impeccable/miss-dee-brief.md` records the approved replacement direction.
keyCharacteristics: A native book disclosure keeps the long story closed until opened.
Three chronological chapters contain 19 scenes, each with prose, lead media, and the rest of that exchange.
Cormorant carries the story; DM Sans carries controls and annotations.
Botanical imagery and restrained paper depth connect the cover, reader, and personal letter.
Original recordings play on demand; games never gate the ending.

rules.name: The reading contrast rule
rules.body: Keep narrative text in ink or green on paper or sheet. Use muted text for annotations and maroon for short emphasis.

rules.name: The prose first rule
rules.body: Give the narrative serif the reading space. Keep dates, controls, and media counts in the smaller sans-serif voice.

dos: Do connect every story image and recording to its dated scene and surrounding prose.
Do keep the book closed initially and retain the native disclosure fallback.
Do preserve the original recordings, their sound, and playback controls.
Do keep games, flexible plans, notes, and the personal letter available outside the book.
Do use approved face and horse crops in both full-size files and thumbnails.
Do maintain image provenance when replacing assets.
donts: Don't restore the random gallery, category filters, or removed private compositions.
Don't autoplay recordings or allow competing players.
Don't gate the story or letter on completing games.
Don't turn uncertain dates, flexible plans, or chapter four into factual promises.
Don't apply this identity to the unrelated Hugo blog.
